propositions: Empty parsed acceptance criteria checklist items must fail standalone clarity checks and plan-review P1 readiness.
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail deterministic P1 readiness when they appear as value assignments.
Sentinel matches must be suppressed when the same line contains case-insensitive negation or removal terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without).
Fenced code blocks and inline backtick-escaped code must not trigger sentinel-based clarity failures.
Shared pure plan-structure parser must be implemented in a single module and wired into both standalone clarity and plan-review P1 gates without changing ticket-type exemptions.
